title: David Huggins' encounters with mantids, grays and a hybrid woman

tellings.quote: And he claimed that the mantids were in charge of these little grays

plain: A man named David Huggins claimed encounters with mantids, tall insect-like beings, and with grays, small gray-skinned beings, and said the mantids "were in charge of these little grays"; his story also includes a hybrid woman, part human and part alien, and takes place in the US South and in underground places. The researcher Jason Jorjani relays this to Michels as what Huggins claimed. If true, it would point to a ranking among different kinds of beings.
